owner: Dept D/C worker (child session 2026-11-08, D-025); Pre-registration Officer: Director's brief
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Prokopczuk, Wese Simen and Wichmann ('The Natural Gas Announcement Day Puzzle', Energy Journal 42(2) 2021, abstract only): more than half of the NG futures annual return is earned on EIA weekly storage report days, not explained by the surprise; a premium for holding NG through the week's main scheduled shock (candidates.md rank 5, AF C-2-01). Sign fixed: LONG NG over the report day.
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1h, stype_in=continuous, symbol <ROOT>.v.0 (front by volume), purchased 2026-11-08 by batch job (estimate row in data/databento_spend_ledger.csv first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet with ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 go only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/<dataset>_holdout.parquet. A 1h bar exists only if the contract traded in that hour. Every ET time below is America/New_York via zoneinfo; because ET is a whole-hour offset from UTC, 'the bar opening HH:00 ET' is exactly one Databento bar. Roll rule (ex ante): a return between two prices is used only if both bars carry the same instrument_id (the .v.0 mapping changes at a session boundary); otherwise the observation is ineligible and counted. Events: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report release days from cal_eia_ngsr (rebuilt by src/qe/ingest/calendars.py from ir.eia.gov/ngs/schedule.html and the Thursday 10:30 ET rule); events with holiday_week=True before 2025 (real date unverified) are skipped ex ante. For release day R: ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 18:00 ET on the Globex evening that starts session R (the calendar day before R); if missing, the OPEN of the first existing bar opening 19:00..21:00 ET that evening, else no trade. EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening 14:00 ET on R (last trade before 15:00 ET, after the 14:00-14:30 settlement window); if missing, the CLOSE of the last existing bar opening 11:00..13:00 ET on R (counted), else no trade. Entry and exit bars must carry one instrument_id. Event P&L (fraction of account) = w*ln(P_exit/P_entry) - costs. No stops, no targets.
parameters: entry 18:00 ET bar open on the evening before the release day; exit 14:00 ET bar close (=15:00 ET) on the release day; +-25% neighbours (fixed now): entry at the OPEN of the 09:00 ET bar on R (hold 6 h, the brief's alternative entry; x0.29 - the only other pre-named entry) and exit at the CLOSE of the 12:00 ET bar (=13:00 ET, hold 19 h, x0.90); EWMA centre of mass 45 and 75; one-bar delay variant = entry at the OPEN of the 19:00 ET bar; volatility terciles = NG trailing 20-session s.d. of the 18:00->15:00 return (IS bounds)
instruments: NYMEX NG front futures (by volume); micro MNG / QG for sizing
holding: 21 h (18:00 ET Wednesday -> 15:00 ET Thursday), one trade per week, about 50 per year
data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (bought / rebuilt after this registration): the sha256 of the derived parquet and of the rebuilt calendar is written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read (the old cal_eia_ngsr pin 024c8949... is checked against the rebuild and any difference printed)
vol_scaler: w = (0.10/sqrt(252))/sigma, sigma = EWMA (centre of mass 60 sessions, at least 40) s.d. of NG's own 18:00->15:00 ET session log return over ALL prior sessions with valid bars, through the previous session; no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x per side on notional ($10,000 x price): NG 1 tick ($0.001 = $10) + $2.50 (about 4-6 bp per side at $2-3, about the 7-10 bp RT in the candidate brief); charged at entry and exit. 2x run attached (every per-side cost doubled).
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (the IS read for EWMA warm-up precedes it): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West and the event/day-clustered t of the net-1x series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md: at least 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, at least 2 of 3 volatility terciles (bounds from IS) positive, the +-25% neighbours listed in parameters all net-positive, and the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on the *_holdout datasets in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Verdict mechanically: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3) hold; NEAR-MISS if the deciding t is within 1.0 of the bar (t >= 2.6807) with the bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL (refuted under the row's rule). Before the OOS read, on IS only: the truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; the decision must not change) and the perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) must pass on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Series: the per-event net P&L (one observation per release day; NW lag 4). Concentration also requires no single year > 50% and the best 5 events < 50% of a positive net. Sub-periods (information only): 2019-2021, 2022-02.. (LNG/Europe shock).
notes: Source: research/triage-2026-11-08.md class C #2 (AF C-2-01). Closed families: E2 (macro events ES/NQ) different asset and mechanism. HONEST PRIOR about 0.05 (abstract only; sign and size unseen).
